meta.title: Highgate — English that finally clicks
meta.description: Online English from A1 to C1: short lessons, clear explanations and a real teacher. Start with a free lesson.

hero.title: English that <it>finally</it> <hl>clicks.</hl>
hero.lead: No cramming and no shame about mistakes. Short lessons, clear explanations and a teacher who actually answers. Start with a free lesson — just see how it feels.
hero.note: No payment. We won't call unless you ask.

collage.note: Great work with tenses! On Friday we'll cover Past Perfect — it's easier than it looks.

homePage.manifesto: Learning a language <it>isn't about talent.</it> It's about small steps every day and a person nearby who'll <soft>help when you get stuck.</soft>

feel.title: How it <it>feels</it>
feel.oneText: Fits into a lunch break or a commute. Video, short notes and a test — all on one page, nothing to hunt for.
feel.mistakesText: The test after a lesson is there to help you get the topic, not to grade you. Didn't work out — try again.
feel.humanText: A teacher reviews your work, explains mistakes and answers questions. On Pro and Deluxe.
feel.langTitle: Explained in a language you get
feel.langText: Russian, Uzbek or English — you choose and can switch anytime.

levels.title: Where shall we <it>start?</it>
levels.lead: Pick what sounds like you. Getting it wrong is fine — you can change your level.
levels.unknownDesc: A 15-minute test — and we'll suggest a course right away

s1.title: Try it for free
s1.text: A trial lesson and a level test — no payment. See the format and decide if it's for you.

s2.title: Choose how to learn
s2.text: On your own, with review or with a teacher. The lessons stay with you forever.

s3.title: Go at your own pace
s3.text: Lessons open in order and your progress is visible right away. Stuck — message your teacher.

pricing.title: What it <it>costs</it>
pricing.note: Lessons stay with you forever. Teacher sessions and reviews last for the plan's term.

items.q: What if I'm a total beginner?
items.a: Then we start at A1 — with the very first words and phrases. Explanations in your language, nobody will rush you.

items.q: How much time do I need a day?
items.a: 15–20 minutes is enough — that's one lesson. A little every day beats three hours once a week.

items.q: Can I learn only from my phone?
items.a: Yes. Lessons, notes and tests work well on a phone, and live classes run on Zoom.
Online, on Zoom: one-on-one lessons with a teacher and group classes — that's the Deluxe plan. The schedule is always in the Live section.

items.q: What happens when my plan ends?
items.a: The lessons and materials stay with you. Only reviews and teacher sessions end.

lead.title: Let's <it>just</it> talk
lead.text: Leave your number — we'll call back, help you find your level and choose a course. No pressure, honestly.

aboutPage.title: Hi, we're <it>Highgate</it>
aboutPage.story: We wanted English to be <hl>clear and pressure-free</hl> — so that's how we teach: short lessons, in your language, with a real person nearby.
aboutPage.v1Text: Didn't get a topic? That's normal. Ask, and it'll be explained a different way.
aboutPage.v2Text: You can't learn a language in a month. But in a month you can move forward noticeably — and feel it.
aboutPage.v3Text: Bought a course — the materials stay with you even after your plan ends.
